authority.scope: Validate the authorized GTK2 Theme Lab coupled and detached preview controller route; do not install to the user session.

test.implementation: Current Motif controller probe with native GTK2 2.24.33 GtkPlug/GtkWindow under bwrap and private Xvfb; binary rebuilt from current controller/view/model sources before both runs.
test.initial_metrics: Coupled horizontal scrollbar 220x15 and vertical scrollbar 15x180; detached route exposes matching dimensions.
test.apply_metrics: After changing horizontal width to 280 and applying, both GTK2 origins report 280x15; vertical remains 15x180.
test.persistence: GTK2 width persists as 280 while GTK3 width remains 220. Closing the detached preview leaves the coupled GTK2 child mounted and reports the closed state.
test.recipe: Theme Lab recipe remains partial; this test does not claim all 16 translated controls are embedded or fully styled.

limits: This verifies the coupled GTK2 scrollbar pair and controller Apply/persistence/lifecycle, not full coupled rendering and interactions for every translated control.
The historical held-state comparison for left, right and up remains pending until the project VM visibly shows the guest pointer on each target.
The final GTK2 control audit and user visual review remain open.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Adds two successful runs of the current controller's GTK2 coupled scrollbar route, detached route, Apply propagation and persistence while retaining R297 public-native interaction evidence. Remaining embedded-control coverage, historical held-state comparisons, final audit and human review are open. This is not a visual-fidelity score.
